t: You're looking at Two Piece Reclining Figure No. 3, a sculpture by Henry Moore on the Brandon Estate. Moore made it, and it carries the catalogue number LH 478. He is best known for semi-abstract monumental bronze sculptures, which stand as public works of art around the world. He also drew a great deal, including a series of Londoners sheltering from the Blitz during the Second World War. This piece belongs with that wider body of public work.
